items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.U.1: Recall and apply basic multiplication facts
items.text: What is $7 \times 8$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.U.2: Identify prime numbers up to 50
items.text: Which of the following is a prime number?

items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.U.3: Calculate percentages of quantities
items.text: What is $25\%$ of $80$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.O.4: Add and subtract fractions with different denominators
items.text: Evaluate $\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{4}$.
items.khanAcademyRef: KA: Adding fractions with unlike denominators

items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.H.5: Apply ratios to share quantities
items.text: Two friends share \u20ac120 in the ratio $3 : 5$. How much does the friend with the larger share receive?

items.learningOutcome: JC.NU.H.6: Simplify expressions involving surds
items.text: Simplify $\sqrt{50} + \sqrt{18}$ in the form $a\sqrt{2}$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.U.1: Evaluate algebraic expressions for given values
items.text: If $x = 4$, what is the value of $3x + 2$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.U.2: Solve linear equations with one variable
items.text: Solve for $x$: $2x + 3 = 11$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.O.3: Expand binomial products
items.text: Expand $(x + 3)(x - 2)$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.O.4: Factorise quadratic expressions
items.text: Factorise $x^2 - 5x + 6$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.H.5: Solve simultaneous linear equations
items.text: Solve the system: $x + y = 7$ and $x - y = 1$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.AL.H.6: Solve quadratic equations using the quadratic formula or factorisation
items.text: Find the solutions of $x^2 - 4x - 5 = 0$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.U.1: Recall properties of angles on a straight line
items.text: Two angles lie on a straight line. One is $110^\circ$. What is the other?
items.khanAcademyRef: KA: Angles on a straight line

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.U.2: Calculate the area of a rectangle
items.text: A rectangle has length $8\,\text{cm}$ and width $5\,\text{cm}$. What is its area?

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.O.3: Apply the Pythagorean theorem in right-angled triangles
items.text: A right-angled triangle has legs of length $3$ and $4$. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.O.4: Calculate the volume of a cuboid
items.text: A cuboid has dimensions $4\,\text{cm} \times 3\,\text{cm} \times 2\,\text{cm}$. What is its volume?

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.H.5: Apply trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles
items.text: In a right-angled triangle, the side opposite an angle of $30^\circ$ has length $5$. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
items.khanAcademyRef: KA: Trigonometric ratios in right triangles

items.learningOutcome: JC.GT.H.6: Use coordinate geometry to find the distance between two points
items.text: Find the distance between the points $A(1, 2)$ and $B(4, 6)$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.U.1: Evaluate a function at a given input
items.text: If $f(x) = 2x + 1$, what is $f(3)$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.U.2: Identify the slope of a linear function
items.text: What is the slope of the line $y = 4x - 7$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.O.3: Find the y-intercept of a linear function
items.text: Where does the line $y = -2x + 5$ cross the y-axis?

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.H.4: Find the roots of a quadratic function
items.text: What are the roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 9$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.H.5: Combine evaluation with algebraic manipulation of functions
items.text: If $f(x) = x^2 - 2x$, what is $f(-3)$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.FN.H.6: Identify the vertex of a quadratic function in vertex form
items.text: What is the vertex of the parabola $y = (x - 2)^2 + 3$?
items.khanAcademyRef: KA: Vertex form of a quadratic

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.U.1: Calculate the mean of a small data set
items.text: Find the mean of the data: $4, 6, 8, 10$.

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.U.2: Identify the median of a small data set
items.text: What is the median of the data: $3, 7, 9, 12, 15$?

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.O.3: Calculate simple probability of equally likely events
items.text: A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of rolling an even number?

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.O.4: Determine the range of a data set
items.text: Find the range of the data: $5, 12, 7, 18, 3, 14$.
items.khanAcademyRef: KA: Range of a data set

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.H.5: Calculate probabilities involving combined sample spaces
items.text: Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting exactly one head?

items.learningOutcome: JC.SP.H.6: Interpret correlation from a scatter plot
items.text: A scatter plot shows that as the number of hours studied increases, exam scores tend to increase. Which best describes the correlation?
